text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

An all-male panel that selected a male candidate over you, also male, gives no support to a claim that your sex counted against you. Raising it would signal that you are searching for a grievance rather than making a case, and would weaken the point that actually has force.

That point is procedural: you requested a written explanation two weeks ago and received nothing. Most civil service recruitment frameworks require a substantive response within a set period. Chase it in writing, addressed to the recruitment lead and copied to HR, citing the relevant policy and date of your original request.

Ask specifically how "experience of leading international projects" was weighted and whether it appeared in the published criteria. If it did not, that is your real argument.
